method: Read-only docker inspect/pull/create/export; no container started. Exported filesystem metadata and PMTiles header/gzip JSON decoded without executing image code. Archives/raw extracts retained in ignored .issue-runtime. Registry tag v0.17.1 does not exist; actual release tag is 0.17.1.
findings: Both inspected historical 0.17.1 platforms carry BASEMAP_BUILD 20261026 and Protomaps 4.15.2, with landcover. Both local #347 candidates carry 20261024 and the same schema/version. This supplies the artifact link to the documented Daylight / ESA WorldCover 2020 lineage; it does not establish uninspected releases or future changed inputs.

Neither inspected release nor #347 candidate contains a readable map-assets OFL notice or glyph revision. Native sharp-libvips and Satteri platform package paths contain no LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file. This is an observed notice gap, not proof of compliance or a legal conclusion.

Embedded DHI SPDX has one aggregate package with NOASSERTION, not a complete signed component SBOM. Dpkg status identifies 15 runtime package versions; corresponding package copyright files/common license texts are present except nodejs-26 has an empty doc directory in the inspected arm64 archives.

The current libvips package 1.3.4 has 29 version entries. Its 33 source/patch downloads and 357 librsvg lock crates are now recorded with source directions and delivered notices. Cargo --workspace preserves existing non-workspace versions; original lock sources form a conservative superset after feature removal. Review-time source hashes do not attest past mutable patch bytes or prove a reproduced binary.

satteri.scope: All 154 registry dependencies from the pinned Cargo.lock, including build/dev/optional targets; not exact per-binary linkage. Crate archives matched their lock SHA256. No code executed.
